title: Nico Bravo
overview: There is a superstore called Vulcan's Celestial Supply, where all of the universe's heroes, gods and monsters go to buy their next-level weapons and quest-gear. Fierce fighters outside the store, inside they're calm and quiet thanks the fast mind of the store's head clerk Nico Bravo, the very mortal son of the god Vulcan, the store's owner. So, when Vulcan is suddenly kidnapped, it's up to Nico to gather his band of clerks, arm-up with the shop's best merch, and set out to save the world by rescuing Vulcan from Ahriman, The God Of Evil.

title: High in the Clouds
overview: After he accidentally sparked a revolution against Gretsch, the bossy diva-owl who has banned all music from his town, a teenage squirrel named Wirral embarks on an extraordinary journey to set music free.

title: Dumas: Black Devil
overview: Thomas Alexandre Davy de la Pailleterie Dumas was born a Caribbean slave in 1762 and beat the odds by rising through the ranks to become a revolutionary French general. The son of a nobleman, Marquis Alexandre Antoine Davy de la Pailleterie, and an African slave, Marie-Cessette Dumas, he became the first and highest-ranking Black leader in the French military and served under Napoleon Bonaparte. But despite his many exploits, which earned him the nickname of “Black Devil,” his role in the French Revolution was underplayed and he was even denied a full pension and legion of honor by Bonaparte.

title: Les Enfants de la Résistance : L'escalade
Nacrose
overview: In a post-apocalyptic future, a deadly disease called the "Entraxe" dominates the world. Gabrielle, a cleaning lady in a laboratory, discovers she has the "Entraxe."
